entries.name: neighbors
entries.description: Who/what this entity is connected to, related to, or works with in the knowledge graph. Inherited by every pack type, so a new type is graph- navigable for free. Walks outward `hops` (1–3, default 1); optionally filter relationship types (CSV) and cap with `limit`. Returns the connected nodes nearest-first; empty if this node isn't persisted yet.
